edits.value_json: 爱 is the standardized simplified form of 愛. In current 爱, 爫 sits above 冖 and 友. One graphic-history proposal traces the 友-like lower shape to joined or abbreviated 心-and-夂 strokes in running script; this does not establish an ancient role for 友. In the received analysis of traditional 愛, the gloss is “appearance of walking,” with a walking-related element written 夂 in one account and 夊 in another, and 㤅 as the sound element. The evidence does not establish a chronological change from 夂 to 夊. Accounts differ separately on the upper element of early 㤅.
The matching current Mandarin readings of 㤅 and 愛 do not by themselves establish their historical sound relationship.
No verified historical glyph image is included here.

Accounts of early 愛 distinguish the 㤅 graph from forms analyzed as 愛 with an added 夂 or 夊. One account identifies the upper element of 㤅 as 兂; others identify it as 旡, and another discusses 既 variants. These are competing analyses and regional graphic histories, not one established universal sequence.
